thread:
maya: Heads-up: quick checkin on the private onramp "manifest" we hand to field. Need a one-page JSON + short runbook that customers can follow when they manage BGP/egress. Goal: alpha pilots next month.
ravi: Suggest minimalist keys only: preset, required_customer_steps, verification_cmds, contact. Keep it <200 lines.
monica: For presets propose: vpc-preserve, vpc-minimal, airgap-offline. vpc-preserve = preserve announced prefixes + static cluster egress.
lee: Security: add artifact_signature and kms_instructions for airgap installs. Also require a telemetry allowlist table.
monica: Example handoff snippet for emails: {"preset":"vpc-preserve","required_customer_steps":["announce-prefix","open-icmp","provide-bgp-neighbor"],"verification_cmds":["curl --interface 198.51.100.5 https://release.redwood.ai/healthz"]}
ops-bot: CI notice: private-onramp/e2e bgp-handoff flaky (1/5). Log: https://ci.internal/9901
ravi: Assigning @monica to triage CI capture and @lee for security gating on KMS steps.
maya: Launch gates draft: 1) manifest + runbook published, 2) egress preserved in 2 pilots, 3) rollback drill completes <20m, 4) security sign-off on artifacts. If all pass in 2 customers -> GO. Reconvene Thursday 11:00.
lee: I'll drop KMS test checklist in the drive and tag this thread.
monica: I'll run the CI capture and post results here.
maya: Thanks team, will assemble final manifest and runbook after updates.
